premises.text: Eye diseases progress painlessly until late, so prevention requires regular screening that overloaded ophthalmology capacity cannot deliver at scale
premises.evidence_span: The only way to achieve it is to do regular screening. And they do it for the risk groups of patients. But still, the problem is too big. For example, the biggest risk group is diabetic patients

premises.text: An AI assistant diagnoses retinal disease from fundus images in seconds with >95% accuracy versus ~91% for average human doctors
premises.evidence_span: we've built our artificial intelligence assistant that can help doctor to make diagnosis just in a couple of seconds

premises.text: First customers are optician chains, GPs, and telemedicine firms as the front line of eye care
premises.evidence_span: We see our first customers as optician chains, general practitioners, and telemedicine companies, as they are the first line of eye care today

premises.text: A per-image subscription (~€5) undercuts the lowest Dutch screening price (~€25)
premises.evidence_span: subscription model based on how much images they use monthly, starting with only five euros per image, comparing to the lowest price on Dutch market today is 25 euros per screening

premises.text: Rotterdam Eye Hospital collaboration builds glaucoma-screening image sets and validates the solution as a new ophthalmology standard
premises.evidence_span: we're going to collect and annotate together with them more than 100,000 specialized images for glaucoma screening. And it will be the first glaucoma screening solution in the world

premises.text: Dutch market entry then FDI/FDA path to the US follows study publication
premises.evidence_span: we're going to penetrate Dutch market in the end of this year. And by 2020, we're going to receive our FDI approval and move to US market

premises.text: Retinal imaging can later extend to cardiovascular and neurological disease detection and eventually smartphone retinoscopy
premises.evidence_span: it gives us opportunity to discover cardiovascular diseases and neurological diseases also

value.text: Prevent sight-threatening disease through earlier, accurate retinal screening
value.evidence_span: We don't want to treat patients when it's that bad. We want to prevent it

secondary_value.text: Retina as a window into cardiovascular and neurological health
secondary_value.evidence_span: it's like a window into human's health
